title: 第20章 放屁套餐
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
好一个超级无敌大响屁!

    所有人都给崩蒙了，以至于下意识没发现是个屁，还以为外头打了个惊天大雷呢。

    铁蛋喊：“是妈放的屁。”

    话落还要深深一吸，“妈的屁味我知道。”

    赵玉兰内心的泪水哗啦啦地流，头一回觉得母子之情倒也是无需那么深刻。

    苗苗扭屁股，手舞足蹈的唱跳，“屁屁屁，人间之气，妈放屁洋洋得意，妈不放屁垂头丧气。”

    这会，芽芽绞着腿挪到蔡老太身边，奶声奶气的喊：“奶奶，我夹不住了！！”

    话落也是噗噗噗好几声，还是个连环屁呢。

    蔡老太站得近，捂着鼻子立刻拉孩子裤头看是不是拉了，实在是太臭了！

    这会屁味也扩散了，谁都捂着鼻子纷纷躲开。

    赵玉兰一下子就不尴尬了，笑着打趣小女儿，“你也放屁了吧。”

    芽芽直摇头，“是奶奶放的！”

    蔡老太挑眉，“明明是你放的。”

    芽芽立刻补充，“对，就是明明放的哒。”

    魏建业忽然大喊：“我也得放个屁，但是不知道臭不臭!”

    所有人呼啦啦的走开，半晌没听见声音还得问放了没有，然后才得知魏建业放了个蔫屁。

    地瓜谁都没少吃，下一个大屁出现以后，蔡老太很淡然的认领：“臭屁不响，响屁不臭。”

    完全放开的赵玉兰竟连屁都认领，笑嘻嘻的说：“妈，我也放了一个，咱俩还挺同步。”

    这话惹得蔡老太相当嫌弃，却激起铁蛋的胜负心，一直拍着心窝子撅着腚嚷嚷着要做今日放屁最佳能手。

    到底还是魏建业放了一个九曲回肠的连环屁后彻底惹怒了蔡老太。

    虽然这会还不到九点钟，但竹苗扫帚一做好，一家之主蔡老太把所有人全都赶上床，直嘟哝：“屁崩了一地，别回头来点火星子把屋子炸了。”

    谁都咯咯咯的笑，但也老老实实的躺着，煤油灯都熄了，还能咋的呦。

    小孩子还睡不着，龙凤胎在自言自语，商量着找来一堆放屁高手坐小汽车后面，每个人面前放一堆的大地瓜，一边吃一边放，汽车就能往前开了。

    蔡老太有经验，这时候千万不能接茬，否则就别想睡了。

    里屋的魏建业刚呵呵一笑就被孩子妈捂住嘴消了声，而蔡老太更是一个劲地挠苗苗的背。
content_en:
What a super invincible loud fart!

Everyone was so stunned that they subconsciously didn't realize it was a fart and thought there was a huge thunder outside.

Tiedan shouted: "It was mom who farted."

Before he finished speaking, he took a deep breath and said, "I know the smell of your mother's fart."

Tears flowed from Zhao Yulan's heart, and for the first time she felt that the relationship between mother and child did not need to be so deep.

Miaomiao twisted her butt and danced, singing and dancing, "Butt, butt, butt, the energy of the world. If mom farts, she will feel proud, but if mom doesn't fart, she will be dejected."

At this moment, Yaya twisted her legs and moved to Mrs. Cai's side, shouting in a sweet voice: "Grandma, I can't hold you anymore!!"

The words came out with several pops and pops, and it was a serial fart.

Mrs. Cai stood close, covered her nose, and immediately pulled up the child's pants to see if they had pooped on them. It really stank!

Now the fart smell had spread, and everyone covered their noses and ran away.

Zhao Yulan suddenly lost her embarrassment and teased her little daughter with a smile, "You must have farted too."

Yaya shook her head, "Grandma did it!"

Mrs. Cai raised her eyebrows, "It was obviously you who let it go."

Yaya immediately added, "Yes, it was released obviously."

Wei Jianye suddenly shouted: "I have to fart too, but I don't know if it smells bad or not!"

Everyone walked away in a huff. For a long time, they didn't hear any sound and they had to ask if they had farted. Then they learned that Wei Jianye had farted.

No one eats less sweet potatoes. When the next big fart appears, Mrs. Cai calmly admits it: "Smelly farts don't make noise, loud farts don't stink."

Zhao Yulan, who had completely let go, even recognized the fart, and said with a smile: "Mom, I let one go too, we are quite in sync."

This remark made Old Mrs. Cai quite disgusted, but it aroused Tiedan's desire to win. He kept patting his heart and pouting his butt, shouting that he would be the best fart expert today.

After all, it was Wei Jianye who completely angered Mrs. Cai after farting in a series of nine-winding ileum.

Although it was not yet nine o'clock, as soon as the bamboo broom was ready, the head of the family, Mrs. Cai, rushed everyone to bed and kept muttering: "The fart is all over the floor, don't come back and blow up the house with sparks."

Everyone was giggling, but they were still lying down, the kerosene lamp was out, so they could still do well.

The children were still unable to sleep, and the twins were talking to themselves, discussing how to get a bunch of fart experts to sit in the back of a car. They would put a bunch of big sweet potatoes in front of each person and eat them while they put them away, and the car would move forward.

Mrs. Cai has experience. You must not pick up the fight at this time, otherwise you will not be able to sleep.

Wei Jianye in the back room just laughed, but his mother covered his mouth and silenced him, while Mrs. Cai kept scratching Miaomiao's back.
